title: 第11章 六斤的肥野兔
content_zh:
第11章 六斤的肥野兔-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

猎人狩猎到的猎物，是全部的家庭开销，是需要去集市上售卖，补贴家用的。

平日里，也都是吃些粗粮杂粮和野菜，最多来点咸菜厚饼子之类的，逢年过节，或者这次狩猎的野物足够多，才会吃上一些。

而且猎人一般都比较节俭。

毕竟打猎的不可能性太多了，万一一段时间打不到猎物怎么办？万一有一次上山的时候受伤了，家中没有积蓄怎么办？

哪里像山哥。

今天总共就打到三只野兔子，竟然准备全吃了？

“这大热天的，咱们要是不尽快吃了，恐怕也就臭了！”

“再说了，老林子里面猎物多的是，吃完了咱们就再打便是。”

李青山满不在乎道。

今天打到的野兔子，第一只四斤，第二只五斤，第三只也是四斤多，一共不过十三斤，去掉不能吃的皮毛和骨头，大概也就还剩下七斤多的肉。

上火烤了之后，还会进一步减少重量。

其实没多少的。

大壮这个家伙一顿饭吃上一斤多，完全没问题，毕竟一米九的个子，明天早晨起来再吃掉一斤多，也就剩下五斤了。

若是以前，李青山肯定吃不完的。

但是现在不同了。

打完炼体术的拳法后，自己体内的力量会被迅速消耗掉，两顿饭吃掉五斤肉完全没有问题，越是到了后期，肉的需求便越多。

早日炼出纯阳真气！

必须要不心疼的去吃肉。

“嗯，都听山哥的。”

大壮觉得李青山说的很有道理，郑重点了点头，二人便去篝火前开始炙烤野兔。

大黄早就吃饱了肚子。

此刻正蹲坐在一旁酣睡，林子内各种怪异的声音都有，听起来极其瘆人。

没多久。

三只野兔便散发出香喷喷的烤肉香味，李青山和大壮暗自咽了口口水，当即开始大口大口撕咬起手中的兔肉。

李青山吃饱后，便立刻站起身来开始打拳！

一招一式，极其标准！

“娘嘞……山哥，你什么时候又学的拳？”

“打的比我爷都好。”

大壮望着打拳的李青山，脸上满是惊讶，心中暗自腹诽：“山哥这是背着我偷学了多少东西，又是打猎，又是拳法，还会建趟子房？而且这拳法打的，看起来比自己爷打的都好，自己的爷年轻的时候可是武僧出身来着。”

“想学吗？”李青山道。

“罢了罢了，我爷打了一辈子拳，也没打出来什么名堂，我还是躺一会吧！”

大壮摆了摆手道。

李青山打了几遍拳后便停了下来，捡起放在旁边的野兔肉再次大口大口啃食了起来。

然后，再去打！！

Chapter 11 Six pounds of fat hare - "Catch the Mountain 1957: Two pounds of pork in exchange for a wife"

Previous chapter

Save bookmarks

Next chapter

The prey hunted by hunters are all household expenses, and they need to be sold in the market to subsidize the family.

On weekdays, I eat some whole grains and wild vegetables, and at most pickles, thick pancakes and the like. I only eat some during festivals, or if I hunt enough wild animals this time.

And hunters are generally more frugal.

After all, there are too many possibilities for hunting. What if you can’t catch prey for a while?What if I get injured while going up the mountain and have no savings at home?

How does it look like Brother Shan?

I have shot a total of three wild rabbits today. Are you planning to eat them all?

"It's such a hot day, if we don't eat it as soon as possible, it might stink!"

"Besides, there are a lot of prey in the old forest. Let's just hunt again after eating."

Li Qingshan said nonchalantly.

The wild rabbits we shot today were four kilograms for the first one, five kilograms for the second one, and more than four kilograms for the third one. The total was only thirteen kilograms. After removing the inedible fur and bones, there was only about seven kilograms of meat left.

After roasting, the weight will be further reduced.

Actually not much.

It's absolutely fine for Da Zhuang to eat more than a kilogram in one meal. After all, he is 1.9 meters tall. If he eats more than a kilogram when he wakes up tomorrow morning, he will only have five kilograms left.

If it were before, Li Qingshan would definitely not be able to finish it.

But things are different now.

After finishing the physical training technique, the power in your body will be quickly consumed. It is no problem to eat five kilograms of meat in two meals. The more you reach the later stage, the more meat you will need.

Refining pure Yang Qi as soon as possible!

You must eat meat without feeling distressed.

"Well, I listen to Brother Shan."

Da Zhuang felt that what Li Qingshan said made sense, so he nodded solemnly, and the two of them went to roast the hare in front of the bonfire.

The rhubarb was already full.

At this moment, he was squatting aside and sleeping soundly. There were all kinds of weird noises in the forest, which sounded extremely scary.

It didn't take long.

The three hares emitted the fragrant aroma of barbecue. Li Qingshan and Da Zhuang secretly swallowed their saliva and immediately began to bite the rabbit meat in their hands.

After Li Qingshan was full, he immediately stood up and started boxing!

One move after another, extremely standard!

"Mom...Brother Shan, when did you learn boxing again?"

"He beats me better than my father."

Da Zhuang looked at Li Qingshan who was boxing, his face full of surprise, and he secretly cursed in his heart: "Brother Shan secretly learned a lot of things behind my back, including hunting, boxing, and building a house? And this boxing seems to be better than that of my father. My father was a monk when he was young."

"Want to learn?" Li Qingshan asked.

"That's all, my father has been boxing all his life, but he hasn't achieved anything famous. I'd better lie down for a while!"

Da Zhuang waved his hand and said.

After Li Qingshan punched a few times, he stopped, picked up the hare meat lying next to him, and started to gnaw on it again.

Then, go fight again!!
